The '''G9-GP Pulse Drill''' was a handheld [[Beamdrill/Legends|beamdrill]] produced by [[Karflo Corporation/Legends|Karflo Corporation]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. It could be use as a [[Melee weapon/Legends|melee weapon]].<ref name="ETU" />

Developed by the makers of the venerable [[G2-GE beamdrill/Legends|G2-GE beamdrill]], the G9-GP was a handheld, low-powered, precision beamdrill that emitted a rapidly pulsing plasma beam around a millimeter thick, allowing it to cut through relatively thick material. Appearing as long rods with a tank at one end, and a variable-angle plasma cutter at the other, the G9-GP were primarily tools; though in a pinch they could be used as effective improvised weapons.<ref name="ETU" />
